publication_only_GAPS.name: Ahn et al. TNF-alpha binder designs
publication_only_GAPS.why_a_gap: no code released; sequences would be in a supplementary table that has not been retrieved. This is prior art on our EXACT target AND our exact mechanism (interface His against a cation), published after the 21-entry RCSB survey, so it is the single most consequential gap in this ledger.
publication_only_GAPS.blocks: a design of ours could duplicate one of the 72 and we could not tell.

publication_only_GAPS.name: Merck KGaA adalimumab pH-variant patent
publication_only_GAPS.why_a_gap: claims adalimumab variants by kdis ratio >=5/10/15x over wild type. Claim scope, not a sequence set; the PSV rows above are its published examples.
publication_only_GAPS.blocks: nothing for a de novo entry -- recorded as prior art to cite, not to avoid.

meta.how_to_use: Keyed on binder sequence. Before the novelty gate runs, every generated design is checked against these sequences. This is a LOCAL reference and does NOT replace the organisers' checker at upload (playbook s34).
